messages.subject: How to Partition an RDD by Ket in sparkR?
messages.subject_clean: How to Partition an RDD by Ket in sparkR?
messages.body_plain:
Hi

I am fetching data from Hive in my SparkR program. I use map to convert this dataframe to a Pipelined RDD (which consists of a list of lists). How do i partitoon this RDD by certain elements of the list?

groupInput <- (SparkR:::map(cidNoRegFcstInput,function(x){ list(key1=list(col1=x$col1, col2=x$col2), value1=list(x$col1,x$col2, x$col3))}))

groupPartitioned <- SparkR:::partitionBy(groupInput,2, partitionFunc <- function(x){(as.numeric(x$key1$scol1) + as.numeric(x$key1$rcol2))%%2})

However, this gives me the following error:

Error in res[[bucket]] : wrong arguments for subsetting an environment Calls: source -> withVisible -> eval -> eval -> lapply -> FUN

What is the right way to define a custom partitioner in SparkR?

Regards

Radhika

messages.subject: SparkR naming convention
messages.body_plain:
Hi, SparkR developers. Thank for all your work. I'm newbie here, but google a little bit, before opening new thread. I'm surprised about zoo of name conventions used in SparkR -
dot-separated function names (read.df, etc)
underscore-separated function names (group_by, etc)
camel-case-separated function names (groupBy, etc)
Of course, we can use all of these, but I suppose mixing of all of the above is not generally good idea. May be we should create general rules for that? I like Hadley's guide - http://r-pkgs.had.co.nz/style.html, but also I realise, that SparkR build on top of S4 classes and they usually use camelCase naming conventions.
